text: ちっちゃい　ポケモンが　すき　おっきいのは　こわい　から　いや

structure.jp: ちっちゃい　ポケモンが　すき
こわい　から　いや

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の after a describing word stands in for a thing already mentioned, like 'one' in English. おっきいの = 'big ones'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives it as the reason for what comes next. こわい から いや = 'I don't like them because they're scary'.
